messages:
emma_sales: Heads-up — new POC with OrbitHealth. They want to test Zephyr-13B-v2 (quantized variants) on Dedicated for summarization + redaction. Need model onboarding checklist, compatibility notes for KV cache and seq length, and delta pricing for quantized variant vs fp16. Any infra owners?

raj_engineer: I'm around. Quick checks: does Zephyr's KV cache layout match our persistent-kv format? If not, we'll need an adapter. Also need peak memory numbers at seq=2048. Can you drop the model artifact link?

emma_sales: Artifact (customer-provided): https://s3.customer/zephyr/13b/v2/artifact.tar.gz. They asked about latency SLO: p95 < 200ms for single-turn 512 tokens. Also want on-prem option later.

sophie_solution: @raj we should run a compatibility scan. I can kick off a smoke run on Dedicated staging. Need exact quant config they plan to use (int4 vs 3bit). Also note: finance wants per-token vs flat hourly for Dedicated POC — will need a quote.

ben_research: FYI Zephyr uses grouped-row quant and our runtime currently supports int4 grouped kernels but not native 3-bit packing. 3-bit will hit the fallback path (slower). Expect ~20-30% perf regression vs int4 if we keep 3-bit.

raj_engineer: That matches my concern. If we accept the artifact as-is, fallback -> latency risk. Options: 1) ask customer for int4 variant, 2) add a one-off kernel (engineering time), 3) run on beefier nodes to mask perf. Recommend int4 for POC to keep risk low.

security_eng: For enterprise onboarding — we need SOC2 attestation and model provenance (origin + checksum). Please have OrbitHealth complete our short questionnaire: https://redwood.app/sec/questionnaire. Also confirm if they require customer-managed keys (CMK) for model artifacts and inference telemetry.

emma_sales: They want CMK in Dedicated and strict retention controls for embeddings. Legal flagged data retention for LLM outputs/embeddings. Can we support per-customer cache isolation + TTL/purge?

raj_engineer: Dedicated supports tenant-scoped KV namespaces already. We can enable per-tenant TTL and on-demand purge; audit logging needs to be enabled per environment. I'll draft the minimal config we need from them.

emma_sales: Please paste that minimal config so I can forward to OrbitHealth.

raj_engineer: Minimal config (for POC):
```
model: zephyr-13b-v2
variant: int4
sequence_length: 512
kv_cache: tenant-isolated
cmk: true
sla_goal: p95<200ms
retention_policy: ttl=30d
```
Send that to them and ask for int4 if possible. If they insist on 3-bit, we'll scope perf work.

sophie_solution: Pricing note: For a 2-week Dedicated POC we typically offer 50% off reserved node list + metered token billing. If they push high concurrency or >x tokens/day, we add a usage uplift. I'll coordinate with finance and send a written quote.

emma_sales: Thanks. @ben_research any quick notes on accuracy/regression when swapping int4 vs 3-bit? They care about redaction correctness.

ben_research: Expect ~1-3% drop on semantic tasks with int4 vs fp16; 3-bit may increase false negatives on edge cases. For redaction (safety-critical) run a targeted eval set — I'd recommend 200-500 labeled cases.

emma_sales: I'll ask OrbitHealth for an eval set and confirm CMK. Next steps: @raj run compatibility scan on staging with the artifact (prefer int4 variant if they can provide). @sophie coordinate pricing/finance and draft the POC quote. @security_eng send questionnaire link to OrbitHealth. I'll update the deal handoff doc and loop legal.

infra-bot: deploy-staging: model-scan job queued (job id 88932). Status: queued.

raj_engineer: Got it — starting scan now against staging Dedicated pool. Will post results here in ~2 hours (memory profile, kernel fallback flags, rough p95).

emma_sales: Awesome — please include perf delta if fallback kernels are needed. I'll push the int4 ask to OrbitHealth in the meantime. :thumbsup:
